Since \(RST\) is equilateral,
\[
\angle RTS=\angle RST=60^\circ.
\]

The rotation about \(T\) sends \(S\) to \(V\), so
\[
TS=TV.
\]
Thus \(\triangle STV\) is isosceles.

From the diagram, \(TR\) lies inside \(\angle STV\), so
\[
\angle STV=\angle STR+\angle RTV
=60^\circ+70^\circ=130^\circ.
\]
Therefore the two base angles of \(\triangle STV\) are
\[
\angle TSV=\angle SVT=\frac{180^\circ-130^\circ}{2}=25^\circ.
\]

Since \(SV\) lies inside \(\angle RST\),
\[
\angle RSV=\angle RST-\angle TSV
=60^\circ-25^\circ=35^\circ.
\]

\[
\boxed{35^\circ}
\]
